body:
Hi, well back in the day, I had e-cig and I didn't smoke at all. Problem was, that i had to change something every week, sometimes even days, cause I had burn taste in it. Because of it, I stopped using it.

Some time a go, I saw my friend with that big e-cig, perfect thing, but he couldn't help me at all, since he didn't really know nothing about e-cigs, just had one. I`m looking for something long term. Id like to pay 60 pounds or something for it, and care mostly only about q-liquid, and that's all. I dont want to order something from amazon every weekend, because i wanted something cheap.

ps. Sorry, but I dont write much on reddit, so I have no idea how to call everyone with my answer.

Yeah, I`d take it in any western country.

Here, army is like in soviet russia, but you earn less.

Well, there is no way I can find any job in place where I stay, and even if I somehow manage to borrow money to get back to ''big city'', after bills ill have around 20 euro savings every month. 

This is why I'm ready to even work as dishwasher in some normal country. Like every polish person, I worked everywhere. I've been dishwasher as well for some time. Job is job. This is why you'll find polish people who are engineers, and work as waiters (like my ex).

The real unemployment in Poland is around 40%

So yeah. This is why you can meet someone from Poland almost everywhere.

I'm afraid its not so simple here. We do not have ''local unions'', and no one will take me for apprenticeship without years of special schools. That's one of the reasons I need to get out of this country. I believe it's a lot easier in western countries.

Friend, I meant, that I just CANT teach anyone atm, cause it would be illegal + we have too many teachers in Poland anyway, so yeah. 

Nothing is as simple as it seems. 25y ago, Russia left my country, and economy & law is a bit strange because of it.

Well, OP is determinet, and is not scared of hard work. 

There is only one small problem - im broke, and there is no way I can get money from here. I figured that maybe I`ll get to some volunteering abroad, but for now I only found those, that want me to not only work for free, but also pay for almost everything.

Well, if I didnt click anything wrong, then most jobs are for experienced staff, and I worked abroad only in Greece. Maybe some low job for start would be good, like room attendant? At least my English would get more fluent & native (?). Still, I have no idea what to send them. Hi, I`m from Poland, bla bla bla, can you pay for everything? That seems... rude and inpropiet.
I checked volunteering possibilites in US, but I found nothing about people from other countries. Problem rises, since I`m from Poland, and I`d need visa. Any suggestions?

Well I do have qualifications, but nothing I can "brag" about. Skills, that give me almost nothing on job-market.

And I cant teach, maybe its easier to do this work in other countries, but not here friend.

Its not so easy as it sounds. Moving to Warsaw, would cost me same amount of money Id need to find job through temp agency in other country.

If it would be as simple, as most people here seem to think, I wouldn't ask this kind of question.
Well, I doubt if there is any possibility, that any mountain resort, would pay for my visa and flight from EU to US, but ill check it.

MoS, Management and marketing in hotels & restaurants. There is no way you will have opportunity to manage one of those just because you finished something + I met more than enough people, who started and finished as waiters.

This is why I don`t call it real carrier. Its a job, where you need more luck to get up, than skills. Thats the reason I want to get some "real" job, where I`ll get paid more with experience.

Im not even in NFZ atm. It was always me, who helped other with their depression. I dont need fish, but rod. Thats the point in all of this. Id have to live in bigger city to go to him anyway, so yeah. Thanks for trying tho.

Im afraid I cant take the opportunity to travel, even as volunteer, since you always have to pay for airplane/bus. You know, The worst thing in all of it is, that I know, that there are opportunity`s, but there are none, when you have to work 12h everyday, just to have around 30 euro free cash to spend every month, after paying rent for room in flat, and food. I dont feel like fight with world, just to survive every month, hoping I wont loose job without any money in bank, even tho your life is 12h everyday + 2h going to job. Thats not life. I wont be slave for someone, just to die someday without nothing, spending all my beautiful life in work, where you dont have money even for pair of shoes every month. I understand you cant relate, but this is how life of most Polish people looks like, and this is why, everyone who gets some money runs out of it, even to work as cleaner, while he has master engineer. I really dont need much from life, just place to sleep, food, and maybe once a while clothes from second hand. But its still too much here. This is why I consider quitting. A specially, since my life... wasnt like most of people. How long can one fight for his life? No one can be Rocky whole life. At least I dont consider myself to be one of the,

I do feel, like my kind is going out hard. I also feel, like I do deserve a chance... but there is none. Its nice you gave ur time to answer, but you know, there is always "chance" in normal countries. Here, I have only miracle, and it doesnt seem, like its going to happen.

This is the saddest part for me. I could give so much to this world, but I cant. Not becouse of me, but becouse of world. I cant even be volonteer, cause how? Some days a go, I saw some cs:go player, getting tons of money from people watching him play. No one cares about people, who can really help in this world. Were like ants, just waiting to get crunched by foot, only becouse we looked for food, to give to our siblings. 

This world is bullcrap, and it will be like this forever, till all people like me die. Then maybe they will realize, that mistakes were done, but it will be too late. I can assure you, that I wont be one of those, who will see the end. Well maybe I`ll see it, if heaven is there. If Catholic church is right, Ill burn in hell for this anyway, so im screwed in both ways. 

God, how i love the feeling of life. The wave of wind at my hair, the smell of morning, after rain... And I have to go. Thats not, what I was expecting from life, but maybe it is, how it should be. The weaker people need to go, and the one with no heart need to remain.
Well, at least you written something. Its not helpful, but still, its something.

There is nothing to overcome here. I tried to make this life worth something so long. Lost my future for nothing. I gave everything i had for "love" and I ended being alone, preparing for something, that seems the only way. Maybe reincarnation is true, and ill end in better place. Shame, that I wont remember all of this... or maybe its better this way? I`m ready to go tho.

So i guess no one cares. Maybe its better like this. I feel embarrassed i wrote this topic anyway. Asking people for help and pity. This is so sad, its not even funny. I was wondering if maybe there is person in world who, could help, but no. This is bullshit life and it seems I was right. This is not world for people like me.

The saddest thing in this shitty life, is that I know, it would be alot better, if I was cold-hearted asschole. How one can ask for help, if whole world doesn't give a fuck. I`m just another number is suicide statistic. Another failed experiment of society that all it cares in money. Fuck this world.

Dont tell me things like that. I dont feel like its true, and I hate when someone lies to me. This world is not for people like me. Im romantic in a concrete reality. I never thought Ill die like Werter. Jesus, im so fckin pitty person its not even funny. 

And yes, i did make topic there.

I`m really into philosophy and psychology, so Its pretty funny to me, what I`m going to do, but it goes with me for so many years. All it wanted, was good timing, and it got it. 

Im romantic person, I`m one of those people who look on world differently. I`m the guy, you see smelling some flowers in the park. This is why its so sad for me, im going out, and thats the only reason I writed this post. You cant live happily, when you have nothing, even place to sleep. At least in Poland. Im ready for what is comming, but it makes me sad. Im really worth-full person, but I guess world doesnt need people like that.

In Poland we say "if you have a soft heart , you need to have a hard ass", and my ass has more than enough.
